behavior: The real application starts with Badger, SQLite, and an embedded catalog under an explicit Starport home.
Starmap roots, workspace, port, and administrator token are present in configuration input and process environment. The Starmap directory and sentinel contents remain unchanged.
The gateway rejects the Starmap administrator token with HTTP 401 and accepts its own stored API key with HTTP 200.
The Starport catalog runtime directory contains persistent state.
limitations: Local qualification uses an unpublished workspace pair. Required native qualification, published dependency, review, and merge remain open.
CSP10 is not complete. Other primary cases and required subcases remain unverified.
next_action: Continue A17 raw HTTP contracts for both API families, unsupported fields, identity errors, and streaming through catalog refresh.
status: All six A25 subcases pass for the local candidate pair; released-pair qualification remains open
